description: This file is a C source file containing utility functions for time handling, Windows system library loading, and various platform-specific implementations used in the curl project. It appears to be a test utility source file, likely used in the libtest/testutil suite for timing functions and system interactions.

methods.name: struct:timeval tutil_tvnow(void)
methods.description: Returns the current time as a struct timeval, with platform-specific implementations for Windows, monotonic clock, gettimeofday, or fallback to time().

methods.name: long tutil_tvdiff(struct timeval newer,struct timeval older)
methods.description: Calculates the difference in milliseconds between two timeval structures, with the newer time expected to be more recent.

methods.name: double tutil_tvdiff_secs(struct timeval newer,struct timeval older)
methods.description: Calculates the difference in seconds (with subsecond resolution) between two timeval structures.

methods.name: HMODULE win32_load_system_library(const TCHAR * filename)
methods.description: Loads a system library on Windows given its filename, constructing the full path using GetSystemDirectory.

ctags.name: tutil_tvdiff
ctags.pattern: /^long tutil_tvdiff(struct timeval newer, struct timeval older)$/

ctags.name: tutil_tvdiff_secs
ctags.pattern: /^double tutil_tvdiff_secs(struct timeval newer, struct timeval older)$/
